        # Random restart

                while len(set(positions)) < 3:

                vals = [grid[p[0]][p[1]] for p in positions]
                for k in range(3):
                    grid[positions[k][0]][positions[k][1]] = vals[(k+1)%3]
            
            new_score = score(grid)
            
            if new_score >= current_score or random.random() < 2.718**((new_score - current_score) / max(temp, 0.01)):
                current_score = new_score
                if current_score > best_score:
                    best_score = current_score
                    best_grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
            else:
                # Revert
                if move_type == 'swap':
                    grid[i1][j1], grid[i2][j2] = grid[i2][j2], grid[i1][j1]
                else:
                    vals = [grid[p[0]][p[1]] for p in positions]
                    for k in range(3):
                        grid[positions[k][0]][positions[k][1]] = vals[(k+2)%3]
            
            temp *= 0.9999
        
        if best_score == 0:

    return best_score, best_grid
